agent_explanation: Shrunk scenario is single ball (r=0.5,m=1,e=1) dropped from y=3.4 with large dt~0.0308. At step24 ball near ground y=0.67 speed 7.25 falling, energy ~32.95. At step25 it bounces: vy=+8.62 larger than incoming, total energy jumps to 42.34 exceeding E0*1.1+5=41.68. Cause: semi-implicit Euler + coarse substep collision handling with perfectly elastic wall creates numerical energy gain on impact; bounce velocity magnitude increases instead of decreasing or staying equal, violating energy conservation. Reducing dt to 0.001 removes violation.
